Filmmaker questions 'Panchayat' series' caste and religious representation

Filmmaker Neeraj Ghaywan has raised concerns about the representation of caste and religion in the TVF series 'Panchayat'. He noted that all characters in the series appear to be from upper castes, with no Muslim representation. Ghaywan also pointed out that the series was created by IIT graduates, implying a potential disconnect or oversight in its portrayal of social dynamics.
